quote.exact: The boys are finally in Europe

The Japs are beginning to believe it is worthwhile to shoot
and run

annotations.note: Uses the wartime slur 'Japs'. In context: after losing Munda (Aug. 5), the Japanese were pulling back through the central Solomons, and the Allies bypassed Kolombangara by landing on Vella Lavella (Aug. 15, 1943).

quote.exact:
Contrary to
Public Opinion the Japs are smart

annotations.note: Wartime propaganda often portrayed the Japanese as inferior. Men in combat areas knew better.
The envelope itself was not scanned.
